name: Rosa canina extract
description: Rosa canina extract (CAS 84696-47-9 ), derived from the fruit of the dog rose plant, is commercially recognized under FEMA 2990 and sourced for its antioxidant activity and flavoring properties. The extract delivers concentrated rosehip bioactives, including polyphenols and vitamin C, that are valued across cosmetic, food, and nutraceutical formulations. Buyers source it as a functional ingredient. In personal care, it is incorporated into facial serums, moisturizers, and anti-aging creams to provide antioxidant stabilization and support skin-conditioning claims. It is a versatile additive for skincare. Food and beverage manufacturers use it as a natural flavoring in teas, fruit preparations, and functional drinks. Its characteristic rosehip taste profile meets modern clean-label requirements for global brands. Nutraceutical formulators include it in vitamin C-positioned dietary supplements and standardized botanical extracts targeting immune support. Pharmaceutical applications include use in herbal preparations and plant-based formulations. Quality compliance is maintained through rigorous testing. Rosa canina extract is supplied as a liquid extract, dry powder, or spray-dried concentrate depending on the specific target application and stability needs. Standardized grades specifying polyphenol or vitamin C content are available for nutraceutical and pharmaceutical buyers.
